response.overview: Adam Gwon's musical about four young New Yorkers - a woman who cannot let things go, a man who wants to start afresh, an artist and a grad student - whose lives intersect as they search for fulfilment, happiness and love in the city. This UK production from Pickle Productions, directed by Daniel Smith, was fully staged and filmed in a theatre during lockdown and streamed via The Theatre Cafe in spring 2021.
response.title: Ordinary Days
